final: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), totals AS (SELECT SUM(patient_count) AS combined_count, AVG(patient_count) AS average_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.patient_count) AS total_count, AVG(1.0 * sc.patient_count / t.combined_count) AS average_share, AVG(sc.patient_count - t.average_count) AS average_excess FROM sex_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE sc.patient_count > t.average_count
